column1: # rhj_fewshot ablation grid. ONE ROW PER ARM, read by array index.
# Checked in on purpose: index arithmetic in bash is how an arm silently
# becomes a duplicate of its neighbour, and the mapping then lives only in
# shell history. tests/test_rhj_fewshot_grid.py asserts this file is exactly
# the declared Cartesian product with unique ids and unique tags.
